title: Beta evidence record
description: The YAML front matter of one evidence record, parsed to JSON. One record is one observation: one predicate, one cloud (or all), one moment, one build, one verdict.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this format. A change that breaks an existing record adds a new version.

predicate.description: The beta predicate this record is evidence for.

cloud.description: The cloud observed, or `all` for a predicate that is not per cloud. The four slugs are B1's offered set and must change with it.

date.description: When the observation was made, in UTC (RFC 3339, ending in Z). Freshness windows are measured from this value.

buildSha.description: The full 40-character commit SHA of the build under test.

verdict.description: pass, fail, or not-measured. Only pass can make a predicate true.

instrument.description: What made the observation: a repository path (a skill, script or workflow), or `manual` for a hand observation that the body describes step by step.

evidence.description: Where the observation can be checked: repository paths or https URLs. Required on a pass.

aspect.description: A narrower part of the predicate this record covers, as a lower-case slug. Example: `managed-runner` for the B2 runner records.

freshAccount.description: B2: the path started from an account created for this run.

steps.description: B2: the golden-path steps that completed.

path.description: B3: which path the record covers.

substrate.description: B3 agent path: whether the run reached a real cloud or the stub runner.

approvedBy.description: B3 agent path: who gave the human approval. An agent cannot approve its own change.

events.description: B5: the live billing events observed.

check.description: B7: which operations check this record covers.

durationSeconds.description: B7 restore drill: wall-clock time from an empty box to a serving console.

tombstonesReplayed.description: B7 restore drill: erasure tombstones were replayed before the restored console served.

edition.description: B8: the edition whose own predicates this record reports.

allOf.$comment: A pass names where it can be checked.
Predicates that are not per cloud use all.
B2 states the account and the steps; a pass needs a fresh account and all six steps. A managed-runner aspect record is taken during the same run and carries neither.
The B3 agent path states its substrate and who approved. Decision M35: real on hetzner, stubbed on the other three, stated as such; so a hetzner pass must be real.
substrate and approvedBy belong to the B3 agent path only.
B5 lists its events; a pass needs all five.
B7 records are restore drills; a pass replayed the tombstones and states its duration.
Fields that belong to one predicate are refused on another.
